# Atlas (2024 film)
Released on Netflix on May 24, 2024, *Atlas* is a sci-fi thriller directed by Ario Bay and written by Leo Sardarian and Aron Eli Coleite. The film centers on Atlas Shepherd, a tech analyst and the daughter of the creator of an AI terrorist named Harlan. Set in 2071, the story follows Atlas as she leads a military mission to find Harlan, who has escaped to a planet in the Andromeda Galaxy and plans to use AI-driven mechs called ARCs to burn Earth's atmosphere. During the mission, Atlas is captured by Harlan, who intends to wipe out humanity. She is rescued by Smith, an AI she interfaces with to regain control of an ARC, and together they fight to stop Harlan's plans, revealing that Harlan killed Atlas's mother due to jealousy.
The film starred Jennifer Lopez, Simu Liu, Sterling K. Brown, and Abraham Popoola, with principal photography taking place in Los Angeles and New Zealand in 2022. Despite starring Lopez, who also served as a producer, the film received mixed-to-negative reviews from critics. Rotten Tomatoes reported a 19% approval rating, with consensus noting that while Lopez's performance was impressive, the script lacked intelligence and the film's scope was overwhelming. However, the film was a massive success on streaming platforms, debuting at number one on Netflix's most popular English films list with 28.2 million views in its first week and accumulating 60 million global views by mid-June 2024.
